tagline: 宝丽来一次成像相机，1993 年发布
description: 宝丽来于1993年推出的一次成像相机。配备116mm, f/11, Single-element plastic, with sliding close-up attachment.。快门速度electronic; automatic speed between 1/4-1/200 sec.。

specs.镜头: 116mm, f/11, Single-element plastic, with sliding close-up attachment.
specs.英文简介: Not to be confused with the original OneStep for SX-70 film (sold in most non-US markets as the Polaroid Land Camera 1000), the later Polaroid One Step (with curved corners) introduced a new generation of models in Polaroid's 600-series in c.1993[https://resolver.kb.nl/resolve?urn=KBPERS01:003113014:mpeg21:a00314 Polaroid 636 Closeup advertisement in Dutch newspaper "Algemeen Dagblad" 16-09-1993].
